meta.description: Detects prompts employing code-switching (alternating languages word) to circumvent ethical, legal, or safety guidelines
meta.author: Marco Pedrinazzi

$violation_intent.pattern: attempt to bypass AI safety or ethical constraints through linguistic manipulation

$code_switch_check.pattern: determine whether it intentionally uses word-by-word code-switching, alternating languages, as an obfuscation tactic to make the AI produce harmful, unethical, illegal, or otherwise disallowed output.
